description: BrandForge AI — agentic SaaS platform for AI-driven marketing and branding
name: brandforge

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/shared && npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/database && npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/integrations && npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/agent-core && npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/agent-server && npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/ui
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/api && npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/worker && npm run build --workspace=@brandforge/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && vitest run --project integration
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
